key: I was just grabbing a few things for work when this student appeared.
en: I was just grabbing a few things for work when this student appeared.
ja: 仕事道具を取りに来ただけだったんだけど、この生徒が現れて。

key: It seems that she's doing a paper on this kind of machinery for school, and had some questions.
en: It seems that she's doing a paper on this kind of machinery for school, and had some questions.
ja: 学校の課題で、この手の機械についてレポートを書いてるみたいで、いくつか質問があったの。

key: EVE: ...But it seems you two have already met.
en: EVE: ...But it seems you two have already met.
ja: イヴ: ……でも、あなたたち二人はもう会ってるみたいね。

key: FLORA: Haha, what, no! That's totally ridiculous! I've never seen this person in my life!
en: FLORA: Haha, what, no! That's totally ridiculous! I've never seen this person in my life!
ja: フローラ: はは、何、違うって! 馬鹿げてる! この人のこと、生まれてこの方見たこともないし!

key: Also, just wondering, do you usually let strangers walk into your house unannounced?
en: Also, just wondering, do you usually let strangers walk into your house unannounced?
ja: ていうか、ちょっと聞くけど、いつも見知らぬ人を無断で家に上げてるの?

key: That seems a little unsafe, perhaps? It might be good to invest in a lock, or at least start setting proper boundaries!
en: That seems a little unsafe, perhaps? It might be good to invest in a lock, or at least start setting proper boundaries!
ja: ちょっと不用心じゃない? 鍵をつけるか、せめてちゃんと境界線を引いたほうがいいと思うけど!

key: You could start now.
en: You could start now.
ja: 今からでも始めたら?

key: EVE: All right, one of you is going to need to tell me what's really going on here.
en: EVE: All right, one of you is going to need to tell me what's really going on here.
ja: イヴ: いいわ、どちらか一人、本当は何が起きてるのか話してくれる?

key: FLORA: Okay, so I might've bumped into \PN, and we might've talked a little bit about PULSEs already...
en: FLORA: Okay, so I might've bumped into \PN, and we might've talked a little bit about PULSEs already...
ja: フローラ: えっと、\PNとはちょっと会って、PULSEについて少し話したかもしれないんだけど……

key: But he totally got the wrong idea about me!
en: But he totally got the wrong idea about me!
ja: でも、彼、あたしのこと完全に誤解してるの!

key: But she totally got the wrong idea about me!
en: But she totally got the wrong idea about me!
ja: でも、彼女、あたしのこと完全に誤解してるの!

key: But they totally got the wrong idea about me!
en: But they totally got the wrong idea about me!
ja: でも、あの人、あたしのこと完全に誤解してるの!

key: EVE: And what idea would that be?
en: EVE: And what idea would that be?
ja: イヴ: それで、どんな誤解?

key: FLORA: ...Well, \PN seemed to think that I wanted to do something like build my own, and of course that's nonsense! Haha!
en: FLORA: ...Well, \PN seemed to think that I wanted to do something like build my own, and of course that's nonsense! Haha!
ja: フローラ: ……その、\PNは、あたしが自分で作りたいと思ってるとか、そんな風に考えてたみたいなんだけど、もちろんそんなのバカげてる! はは!

key: Especially with how much stress it puts on the Pokémon...
en: Especially with how much stress it puts on the Pokémon...
ja: 特に、ポケモンにあれだけの負担がかかるとなればね……

key: EVE: And you don't want to build one.
en: EVE: And you don't want to build one.
ja: イヴ: それで、あなたは作りたくないのね。

key: FLORA: Of course not! My interest is purely academic!
en: FLORA: Of course not! My interest is purely academic!
ja: フローラ: 当然でしょ! あたしの興味は、純粋に学術的なものだから!

key: EVE: That's why you've been sketching down the schematics when you thought I wasn't looking.
en: EVE: That's why you've been sketching down the schematics when you thought I wasn't looking.
ja: イヴ: だから、わたしが見てないと思った時に、設計図をスケッチしてたのね。

key: FLORA: J-just for education purposes! Haha!
en: FLORA: J-just for education purposes! Haha!
ja: フローラ: べ、勉強のためだから! はは!

key: Forget it.
en: Forget it.
ja: もういいわ。

key: This was going so well, and then you just HAD to come along and ruin it, \PN.
en: This was going so well, and then you just HAD to come along and ruin it, \PN.
ja: せっかくうまくいってたのに、\PN、あんたがわざわざ来て台無しにしなくてもよかったのに。

key: Yeah, I'm going to build my own.
en: Yeah, I'm going to build my own.
ja: そう、あたし、自分で作るつもり。

key: What's a washed-up Champion and a second rate engineer like you going to do about it?
en: What's a washed-up Champion and a second rate engineer like you going to do about it?
ja: 落ちぶれたチャンピオンと、二流エンジニアのあんたたちに、一体何ができるっていうの?

key: EVE: I'm sure I can think of a thing or two.
en: EVE: I'm sure I can think of a thing or two.
ja: イヴ: 一つや二つは、思いつくと思うけど。

key: FLORA: Oh, please. You can't even stop your machines from hurting your own Pokémon.
en: FLORA: Oh, please. You can't even stop your machines from hurting your own Pokémon.
ja: フローラ: はっ、よく言うわ。自分の機械が、自分のポケモンを傷つけるのすら止められないくせに。

key: Or will you say it was negligence rather than incompetence?
en: Or will you say it was negligence rather than incompetence?
ja: それとも、無能じゃなくて過失だったとでも言うつもり?

key: You're the worst kind of person.
en: You're the worst kind of person.
ja: 最悪な部類の人間よね。

key: Scum like you doesn't deserve to hold technology like this.
en: Scum like you doesn't deserve to hold technology like this.
ja: あんたみたいなクズに、こんな技術を持つ資格なんてない。

key: EVE: ...I did not wish the subjects to come to any harm, but I was not afforded a choice.
en: EVE: ...I did not wish the subjects to come to any harm, but I was not afforded a choice.
ja: イヴ: ……被験体を傷つけたいと望んだことは一度もない、でも、選択の余地はなかった。

key: FLORA: Incompetence, then. And excuses.
en: FLORA: Incompetence, then. And excuses.
ja: フローラ: じゃあ無能ってことね。それと言い訳。

key: I'm not interested.
en: I'm not interested.
ja: 興味ない。

key: Obviously you have the Champion wrapped around your finger, but do the local authorities know it was you who was responsible for all the damage?
en: Obviously you have the Champion wrapped around your finger, but do the local authorities know it was you who was responsible for all the damage?
ja: チャンピオンを尻に敷いてるのは分かるけど、地元の当局は、あの被害全部があんたの責任だってこと、知ってるのかしら?

key: I think they might be interested in hearing about that.
en: I think they might be interested in hearing about that.
ja: その話、聞きたがるんじゃないかしら。

key: So unless you want them to find out, you're going to shoo \PN away, and tell me what I want to know.
en: So unless you want them to find out, you're going to shoo \PN away, and tell me what I want to know.
ja: だから、それを知られたくないなら、\PNを追い払って、あたしが知りたいことを教えて。

key: EVE: ...Do you really believe you can fix the subject physical stress issue?
en: EVE: ...Do you really believe you can fix the subject physical stress issue?
ja: イヴ: ……被験体の身体的負担の問題、本当に解決できると思ってる?

key: FLORA: Do I "believe" I can?
en: FLORA: Do I "believe" I can?
ja: フローラ: 「思ってる」?

key: What is this, some feel-good family education crap?
en: What is this, some feel-good family education crap?
ja: 何、これって家族向けの教育番組か何か?

key: I'm GOING to fix it.
en: I'm GOING to fix it.
ja: 解決してみせるの。

key: Unlike some people, I actually care.
en: Unlike some people, I actually care.
ja: どこかの誰かと違って、あたしはちゃんと気にかけてるから。

key: Besides, this region's technology is practically stone age.
en: Besides, this region's technology is practically stone age.
ja: それに、この地方の技術なんて、ほとんど石器時代みたいなもの。

key: If you saw what we're used to back where I'm from, you wouldn't even know what to think of it.
en: If you saw what we're used to back where I'm from, you wouldn't even know what to think of it.
ja: あたしの故郷で当たり前だったものを見たら、あんたどう思っていいか分からなくなるはず。

key: All I need is a living example to confirm, and I've practically cracked it.
en: All I need is a living example to confirm, and I've practically cracked it.
ja: 確認するための生きたサンプルさえあれば、あとはもうほぼ解決したようなもの。

key: EVE: If you're confident that you can solve it, I'll cooperate with you.
en: EVE: If you're confident that you can solve it, I'll cooperate with you.
ja: イヴ: 解決できると自信があるなら、協力するわ。

key: FLORA: It's not an "if".
en: FLORA: It's not an "if".
ja: フローラ: 「なら」じゃない。

key: Glad to hear we have a deal.
en: Glad to hear we have a deal.
ja: 取引成立でうれしいわ。

key: Anyway, \PN, it looks like you're not needed here, so good-bye!
en: Anyway, \PN, it looks like you're not needed here, so good-bye!
ja: とにかく、\PN、あんたはもうここに用なさそうだから、さよなら!

key: EVE: Actually, that's incorrect.
en: EVE: Actually, that's incorrect.
ja: イヴ: 実は、それは違うわ。

key: We'll be needing \PN's help from the outset.
en: We'll be needing \PN's help from the outset.
ja: 最初から、\PNの助けが必要になる。

key: FLORA: Excuse me?
en: FLORA: Excuse me?
ja: フローラ: は?

key: EVE: You said you wanted a living PULSE specimen.
en: EVE: You said you wanted a living PULSE specimen.
ja: イヴ: 生きたPULSEの標本が欲しいと言ってたわね。

key: There's one left.
en: There's one left.
ja: 残りが一体いるの。

key: It was somehow completed without my knowledge.
en: It was somehow completed without my knowledge.
ja: わたしの知らないうちに、なぜか完成していたものが。

key: FLORA: Hmph. Maybe I should've found whoever did that instead...
en: FLORA: Hmph. Maybe I should've found whoever did that instead...
ja: フローラ: ふん。それをやった奴を探したほうが良かったかもね……

key: EVE: Good luck. She's dead.
en: EVE: Good luck. She's dead.
ja: イヴ: 頑張ってみて。彼女は死んだわ。

key: EVE: Good luck. She's gone now.
en: EVE: Good luck. She's gone now.
ja: イヴ: 頑張ってみて。彼女はもういないの。

key: FLORA: ...Tch.
en: FLORA: ...Tch.
ja: フローラ: ……チッ。

key: So where is it?
en: So where is it?
ja: それで、それはどこにあるの?

key: EVE: It's in the Champion's room.
en: EVE: It's in the Champion's room.
ja: イヴ: チャンピオンの部屋よ。

key: FLORA: ...
en: FLORA: ...
ja: フローラ: ……

key: You're kidding, right?
en: You're kidding, right?
ja: 冗談よね?

key: That's a joke.
en: That's a joke.
ja: それ、冗談でしょ。

key: EVE: It's what I've heard.
en: EVE: It's what I've heard.
ja: イヴ: そう聞いてるわ。

key: FLORA: ...Fine.
en: FLORA: ...Fine.
ja: フローラ: ……分かった。

key: FLORA: Then I'm going to Charous Hall.
en: FLORA: Then I'm going to Charous Hall.
ja: フローラ: じゃあ、シャルースホールに行く。

key: That's where the Pokémon League is in this miserable region, right?
en: That's where the Pokémon League is in this miserable region, right?
ja: この惨めな地方のポケモンリーグって、そこにあるんでしょ?

key: Meet me there and our deal for Magearna is back on.
en: Meet me there and our deal for Magearna is back on.
ja: そこで会いましょう、マギアナの取引はまた成立ってことで。

key: But you better not fuck this up for me. Got it?
en: But you better not fuck this up for me. Got it?
ja: でも、これ台無しにしないでよね。分かった?

key: EVE: She seems pleasant.
en: EVE: She seems pleasant.
ja: イヴ: 感じのいい子ね。

key: I recognize that this is an unideal situation, but...
en: I recognize that this is an unideal situation, but...
ja: 理想的な状況じゃないのは分かってる、でも……

key: Lumi's clock is still ticking.
en: Lumi's clock is still ticking.
ja: ルミの時間は、今も刻一刻と過ぎている。

key: If there's something we can do to further her odds, then I'll do it.
en: If there's something we can do to further her odds, then I'll do it.
ja: 彼女の可能性を少しでも広げられることがあるなら、わたしはそれをやる。

key: No questions asked.
en: No questions asked.
ja: 何も聞かずに。

key: Just this once, I'm asking you to do the same.
en: Just this once, I'm asking you to do the same.
ja: 今回だけ、あなたにも同じようにしてほしいの。

key: Please help Flora, \PN. For Lumi's sake.
en: Please help Flora, \PN. For Lumi's sake.
ja: フローラを手伝ってあげて、\PN。ルミのために。

key: EVE: Please help Flora reach the last PULSE in the Champion Room.
en: EVE: Please help Flora reach the last PULSE in the Champion Room.
ja: イヴ: チャンピオンの間にある最後のPULSEにたどり着けるよう、フローラを手伝ってあげて。

key: Returning to our bodies is wonderful, but it just means that Lumi's time is limited again.
en: Returning to our bodies is wonderful, but it just means that Lumi's time is limited again.
ja: 自分たちの体に戻れたのは素晴らしいことだけど、それはつまり、ルミの時間がまた限られたということでもある。

key: This may finally be a way forward.
en: This may finally be a way forward.
ja: これが、ついに前へ進む道になるかもしれない。

key: FLORA: I guess that's about everything.
en: FLORA: I guess that's about everything.
ja: フローラ: これで大体全部かな。

key: Your cooperation is greatly appreciated~
en: Your cooperation is greatly appreciated~
ja: 協力、本当に感謝してるから~

key: And don't worry.
en: And don't worry.
ja: それと、心配しないで。

key: Unlike some people, I'll be making sure from the get go that the Pokémon aren't hurt by my creations.
en: Unlike some people, I'll be making sure from the get go that the Pokémon aren't hurt by my creations.
ja: どこかの誰かと違って、あたしの作るものでポケモンが傷つかないように、最初からちゃんと気をつけるから。

key: EVE: You can stop with the guilt trips already.
en: EVE: You can stop with the guilt trips already.
ja: イヴ: もう、罪悪感をあおるのはやめてもらえる?

key: FLORA: I just hope you've learned your lesson!
en: FLORA: I just hope you've learned your lesson!
ja: フローラ: ちゃんと教訓を学んでくれてるといいけどね!

key: EVE: Your findings were admittedly helpful.
en: EVE: Your findings were admittedly helpful.
ja: イヴ: あなたの発見は、認めるけど役に立ったわ。

key: Splitting the excess energy among several individuals of the same species certainly could act as a bandaid solution until we can solve the problem of over- exposure.
en: Splitting the excess energy among several individuals of the same species certainly could act as a bandaid solution until we can solve the problem of over- exposure.
ja: 余剰エネルギーを同じ種の複数の個体に分散させるのは、過剰暴露の問題を根本的に解決するまでの、応急処置としては確かに使えそうね。

key: It's an intelligent and effective solution.
en: It's an intelligent and effective solution.
ja: 知的で効果的な解決策だわ。

key: FLORA: Oh, I love it when they praise me properly.
en: FLORA: Oh, I love it when they praise me properly.
ja: フローラ: ああ、ちゃんと褒められるの、大好き。

key: EVE: ...But, as I was about to say, your attitude is well beyond insufferable.
en: EVE: ...But, as I was about to say, your attitude is well beyond insufferable.
ja: イヴ: ……でも、さっき言おうとしていた通り、あなたの態度は我慢の限度をとっくに超えてる。

key: Good bye.
en: Good bye.
ja: さようなら。

key: FLORA: Hmph!
en: FLORA: Hmph!
ja: フローラ: ふんっ!

key: Don't be too hasty to push me out the door!
en: Don't be too hasty to push me out the door!
ja: そんなに急いで追い出さなくてもいいでしょ!

key: After all, I still have my half of the deal to uphold for \PN.
en: After all, I still have my half of the deal to uphold for \PN.
ja: だって、あたしはまだ、\PNとの取引の自分の分を果たさなきゃいけないんだから。

key: FLORA: Magearna is still in the Glass Workstation, near where we met.
en: FLORA: Magearna is still in the Glass Workstation, near where we met.
ja: フローラ: マギアナは、まだガラス工房にあるわ、あたしたちが会った場所の近く。

key: It's on the second level.
en: It's on the second level.
ja: 2階よ。

key: I went ahead and set up a ladder so you can reach it, so don't say I never did anything for you.
en: I went ahead and set up a ladder so you can reach it, so don't say I never did anything for you.
ja: 先に、届くようにはしごを設置しておいたから、何もしてくれなかったとか言わないでよね。

key: I would've gone after it myself, but there was so much trash in the way, and that glowy aura around it looked a whole lot like somebody ELSE's problem.
en: I would've gone after it myself, but there was so much trash in the way, and that glowy aura around it looked a whole lot like somebody ELSE's problem.
ja: 自分で取りに行こうかとも思ったけど、ゴミが多すぎるし、あの光るオーラも、いかにも他の誰かの問題って感じだったから。

key: So, you're welcome or whatever.
en: So, you're welcome or whatever.
ja: だから、どういたしましてってことで。

key: I'd say it's been a treat,
en: I'd say it's been a treat,
ja: 楽しかった、とでも言っておくけど、

key: But if it were, it'd be the kind that makes your stomach hurt after eating it.
en: But if it were, it'd be the kind that makes your stomach hurt after eating it.
ja: もしそうだとしても、食べた後にお腹壊すタイプの楽しさだったわね。

key: Ta.
en: Ta.
ja: じゃあね。

key: EVE: I do hope she doesn't do anything we'll regret later.
en: EVE: I do hope she doesn't do anything we'll regret later.
ja: イヴ: 後で後悔するようなことをしないといいけど。

key: Despite herself though, she has opened a door for me.
en: Despite herself though, she has opened a door for me.
ja: 本人の意図とは関係なく、彼女はわたしのために扉を開いてくれた。

key: There's much work to do again, and time is short.
en: There's much work to do again, and time is short.
ja: またやるべきことがたくさんあって、時間は少ない。

key: Please forgive me for not staying to chat.
en: Please forgive me for not staying to chat.
ja: 話し込んでいられなくて、ごめんなさい。

key: Best of luck dealing with the Anomaly.
en: Best of luck dealing with the Anomaly.
ja: アノマリーへの対処、うまくいくよう祈ってる。
